Action: An act performed by an agent on an object, often at a place with an instrument. Also called act, activity, deed, event.
AcceptAction: The act of accepting or adopting something. Also called accepting, approving, agreeing.
RejectAction: The act of rejecting or refusing something. Also called rejecting, declining, refusing.
AchieveAction: The act of accomplishing something. Also called achieving, accomplishing, attaining.
WinAction: The act of achieving victory in a competition. Also called winning, triumph.
LoseAction: The act of being defeated in a competition. Also called losing, defeat.
TieAction: The act of drawing in a competition. Also called drawing, tying.
ActivateAction: The act of starting or activating a device. Also called activating, turning on, starting.
DeactivateAction: The act of stopping or deactivating a device. Also called deactivating, turning off, stopping.
SuspendAction: The act of pausing a device or application. Also called pausing, suspending.
ResumeAction: The act of resuming a paused device or application. Also called resuming, continuing.
ControlAction: The act of controlling a device or application. Also called controlling, operating.
AddAction: The act of adding an object to a collection. Also called adding, inserting.
InsertAction: The act of adding at a specific position in a collection. Also called inserting.
AppendAction: The act of adding at the end of a collection. Also called appending.
PrependAction: The act of adding at the beginning of a collection. Also called prepending.
DeleteAction: The act of removing an object from a collection. Also called deleting, removing.
ReplaceAction: The act of replacing an old object with a new one. Also called replacing, swapping.
UpdateAction: The act of changing or editing the state of an object. Also called updating, editing, modifying.
AllocateAction: The act of assigning resources to a task or object. Also called allocating, assigning.
AssignAction: The act of allocating a task to someone or something. Also called assigning, delegating.
AuthorizeAction: The act of granting permission. Also called authorizing, permitting, sanctioning.
AuthenticateAction: The act of authenticating into a device or application. Also called authenticating, verifying identity.
LoginAction: The act of logging into a device or application. Also called logging in, signing in.
ResetPasswordAction: The act of resetting a password. Also called password reset.
AskAction: The act of posing a question or request. Also called asking, requesting, querying.
ReplyAction: The act of responding to a question or message. Also called replying, responding, answering.
InformAction: The act of notifying someone of relevant information. Also called informing, notifying, telling.
ConfirmAction: The act of confirming a future event will happen. Also called confirming, verifying.
CancelAction: The act of cancelling a future event. Also called cancelling, calling off.
CommentAction: The act of commenting on a subject. Also called commenting, remarking.
CommunicateAction: The act of conveying information to someone. Also called communicating, conveying, contacting.
InteractAction: The act of interacting with a person or organisation. Also called interacting, engaging.
ShareAction: The act of distributing content to people. Also called sharing, distributing, posting.
CheckAction: The act of inspecting or examining something. Also called checking, inspecting, examining.
AssessAction: The act of forming an opinion or judgement. Also called assessing, evaluating, judging.
ReactAction: The act of responding emotionally to something. Also called reacting, responding.
DisagreeAction: The act of expressing disagreement. Also called disagreeing, dissenting.
EndorseAction: The act of approving or supporting something. Also called endorsing, backing, supporting.
LikeAction: The act of expressing positive sentiment. Also called liking, favouring.
DislikeAction: The act of expressing negative sentiment. Also called disliking, disapproving.
WantAction: The act of expressing a desire for something. Also called wanting, desiring.
ChooseAction: The act of selecting from options. Also called choosing, selecting, picking.
VoteAction: The act of selecting from a fixed set of choices. Also called voting, balloting.
IgnoreAction: The act of intentionally disregarding something. Also called ignoring, disregarding.
ReviewAction: The act of producing a review of something. Also called reviewing, critiquing.
BefriendAction: The act of forming a mutual personal connection. Also called befriending, friending.
FollowAction: The act of following someone or something for updates. Also called following.
TrackAction: The act of tracking an object's location for updates. Also called tracking, monitoring.
SubscribeAction: The act of subscribing to receive updates. Also called subscribing.
RegisterAction: The act of registering as a user of a service. Also called registering, signing up.
UnRegisterAction: The act of un-registering from a service. Also called unregistering, deregistering.
JoinAction: The act of joining a group or event. Also called joining, enrolling.
LeaveAction: The act of departing from a place. Also called leaving, departing, exiting.
InviteAction: The act of inviting someone to an event. Also called inviting.
RsvpAction: The act of replying whether you will attend an event. Also called RSVPing, responding to an invitation.
ConsumeAction: The act of consuming content, food, or resources. Also called consuming, using.
EatAction: The act of eating solid food. Also called eating, dining.
DrinkAction: The act of drinking liquids. Also called drinking.
ReadAction: The act of reading written content. Also called reading.
ListenAction: The act of listening to audio content. Also called listening.
WatchAction: The act of watching moving visual content. Also called watching, viewing.
ViewAction: The act of viewing static visual content. Also called viewing, looking at.
PlayGameAction: The act of playing a video game. Also called gaming, playing.
UseAction: The act of using an object for its purpose. Also called using, applying.
InstallAction: The act of installing an application. Also called installing, setting up.
DownloadAction: The act of downloading something. Also called downloading.
CreateAction: The act of creating or producing something. Also called creating, making, producing.
CookAction: The act of preparing food. Also called cooking, preparing.
DrawAction: The act of drawing a picture. Also called drawing, sketching.
PaintAction: The act of painting. Also called painting.
PhotographAction: The act of taking photographs. Also called photographing, shooting.
FilmAction: The act of filming sound and moving images. Also called filming, recording.
WriteAction: The act of authoring written content. Also called writing, authoring.
PerformAction: The act of performing in the performing arts. Also called performing.
PlayAction: The act of playing or performing for enjoyment or competition. Also called playing.
ExerciseAction: The act of exercising for health and fitness. Also called exercising, working out.
WearAction: The act of dressing in clothing. Also called wearing, dressing.
DiscoverAction: The act of discovering or finding something. Also called discovering, finding.
FindAction: The act of finding an object. Also called finding, locating.
SearchAction: The act of searching for something. Also called searching, looking for.
PlanAction: The act of planning a future event or task. Also called planning, scheduling.
ScheduleAction: The act of scheduling future actions or events. Also called scheduling, timetabling.
ReserveAction: The act of reserving something for later use. Also called reserving, booking.
OrganizeAction: The act of organising or administering objects. Also called organising, managing.
OrderAction: The act of ordering goods or services for delivery. Also called ordering.
PreOrderAction: The act of ordering an unreleased product. Also called pre-ordering.
BuyAction: The act of buying goods or services. Also called buying, purchasing.
SellAction: The act of selling goods or services. Also called selling.
PayAction: The act of paying a price. Also called paying, payment.
TipAction: The act of giving money voluntarily for service. Also called tipping, gratuity.
DonateAction: The act of giving goods, services, or money for free. Also called donating, giving, contributing.
QuoteAction: The act of giving a price quote for something. Also called quoting, estimating.
TradeAction: The act of exchanging goods or services for payment. Also called trading, dealing.
MoneyTransfer: The act of transferring money from one place to another. Also called money transfer, remittance.
RentAction: The act of paying for temporary use of something. Also called renting, hiring, leasing.
LendAction: The act of lending an object to be returned later. Also called lending, loaning.
BorrowAction: The act of borrowing an object to return later. Also called borrowing.
GiveAction: The act of transferring ownership of an object. Also called giving, handing over.
TakeAction: The act of gaining ownership of an object. Also called taking.
ReturnAction: The act of returning something previously received. Also called returning, giving back.
SendAction: The act of dispatching an object to a destination. Also called sending, dispatching.
ReceiveAction: The act of taking delivery of an object. Also called receiving, accepting delivery.
MoveAction: The act of an agent relocating to a place. Also called moving, relocating.
TransferAction: The act of moving an object from one place to another. Also called transferring, moving.
TravelAction: The act of travelling from one place to another. Also called travelling, journeying.
ArriveAction: The act of arriving at a place. Also called arriving.
DepartAction: The act of departing from a place. Also called departing, leaving.
CheckInAction: The act of confirming arrival for a reserved service. Also called checking in, check-in.
CheckOutAction: The act of confirming departure from a reserved service. Also called checking out, check-out.
BookmarkAction: The act of bookmarking or tagging an object. Also called bookmarking, flagging, tagging.
SolveMathAction: The act of solving a math expression. Also called solving, calculating.
SeekToAction: The act of navigating to a timestamp within media. Also called seeking, skipping to.
